verdict.rationale: Adyen documents balance accounts created via the Configuration API. Payments can be split between users' balance accounts and the platform's own liable balance account, with costs deducted and funds held until payout. Adyen-generated reports are explicitly positioned for bookkeeping and reconciliation of funds within the platform. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of end-to-end traceability linking each charge to its split and payout, detail on per-seller and fee-account balance reporting or views, documentation that reconciliation works at transaction-level (penny) granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
